HEADER: Init -1; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +33
DEFENSE: AC 31, touch 7, flat-footed 30 (-1 Dex, +34 natural, -2 size)
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Demon Eyes, Eruption, Magnitude 8, trample (4d6+15, DC 30), Wallop
STATISTICS: Str 30, Dex 8, Con 26, Int 5, Wis 19, Cha 10
Base Atk +20; CMB +32; CMD 40 (44 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Diehard, Endurance, Great Cleave, Improved Critical (Bite), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +33, Swim +18; Racial Modifiers +8 Swim
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Demon Eyes (su) The dread gazes from an orothkamila's three eyes each have a separate effect. As a swift action, an orothkamila can switch which of its three gaze attacks is in effect:
Debilitating Eye (su) : Inflicts 5d6 non-elemental damage and the Poisoned (1d6+4 damage) status effect for 5 rounds, with a range of 30 feet, Fortitude DC 28 halves damage and negates poisoned.
Drain Eye (su) : Inflicts 5d6 shadow damage and heals the orothkamila for the amount of damage inflicted, with a range of 30 feet, Fortitude DC 28 negates.
Evil Eye (su) : Inflicts the Statue status permanently, with a range of 15 feet, Fortitude DC 28 negates. All save DCs are Constitution-based.

Eruption (su) As a 1-round action, an orothkamila can call up an eruption of burning earth under the petrified statue of an enemy within 30 feet in order to shatter them, inflicting 100 fire damage and 100 earth damage. If the target of this attack is not suffering from the Statue status effect, they take no damage.

Magnitude 8 (su) Once every 1d6+1 rounds, an orothkamila can cause the ground to erupt wildly around it within a 60-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 15d10 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the weighted status effect for 1d8 rounds. They must make a successful Reflex save (DC 24) to reduce the damage by half and negate the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).
Wallop (ex) An orothkamila's neck muscles are unusually powerful, and great cleave attacks with its bite gain a 1.5x Strength modifier to damage.

curation.summary: Orothkamila is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 24 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
